question: 每个订阅渠道的推送打开数是多少？
sql: SELECT s.channel, SUM(n.opened) FROM newsletter_sends n JOIN subscriptions s ON n.subscription_id = s.id GROUP BY s.channel

question: 推送点击数合计超过 2 的文章有多少篇？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM articles a JOIN newsletter_sends n ON n.article_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING SUM(n.clicked) > 2)

question: 每个标签对应多少篇文章？
sql: SELECT at.tag, COUNT(*) FROM article_tags at JOIN articles a ON at.article_id = a.id GROUP BY at.tag

question: 订单数最多的 5 个省份是哪些？
sql: SELECT prov.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id GROUP BY prov.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: 包含没有商品的类目在内，每个类目有多少个商品？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: 每个大区的退款笔数是多少？
sql: SELECT big.name, COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id GROUP BY big.name

question: 每个供应商供应的商品平均成本是多少？
sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(p.cost) FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name

question: 每个栏目的文章平均字数是多少？
sql: SELECT t.name, AVG(a.word_count) FROM articles a JOIN topics t ON a.topic_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name

question: 每个作者的文章一共收到多少条评论？
sql: SELECT au.name, COUNT(*) FROM comments cm JOIN articles a ON cm.article_id = a.id JOIN authors au ON a.author_id = au.id GROUP BY au.name

question: 每个订阅渠道的推送点击数是多少？
sql: SELECT s.channel, SUM(n.clicked) FROM newsletter_sends n JOIN subscriptions s ON n.subscription_id = s.id GROUP BY s.channel

question: 每个类目涉及多少笔订单？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: 下单次数最多的 10 个客户，各自最后一次下单是哪天？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(o.order_date) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 每个类目下在售的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = '在售' GROUP BY c.name

question: 每个大区的平均订单实付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT big.name, AVG(o.pay_amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id GROUP BY big.name

question: 每个供应商供应的商品里最低售价是多少？
sql: SELECT s.name, MIN(p.price) FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name

question: 每个活动类型的平均订单实付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT ca.type, AVG(o.pay_amount) FROM orders o JOIN campaigns ca ON o.campaign_id = ca.id GROUP BY ca.type

question: 每个大区的评价平均分是多少？
sql: SELECT big.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id GROUP BY big.name

question: 每种支付方式的退款金额合计是多少？
sql: SELECT p.method, SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY p.method

question: 每个类目的商品成本合计是多少？
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.cost) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: 标签数为 3 的文章有多少篇？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT a.id FROM articles a JOIN article_tags at ON at.article_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)
note: 标签数只有 2 或 3，取前 N 必然并列

question: 每个栏目的评论平均分是多少？
sql: SELECT t.name, AVG(cm.rating) FROM comments cm JOIN articles a ON cm.article_id = a.id JOIN topics t ON a.topic_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name

question: 每个大区的订单明细金额合计是多少？
sql: SELECT big.name, SUM(oi.amount) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id GROUP BY big.name

question: 每个大区已签收运单的平均运输天数是多少？
sql: SELECT big.name, AVG(julianday(s.delivered_at) - julianday(s.shipped_at)) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id WHERE s.status = '已签收' GROUP BY big.name

question: 最高售价最高的 5 个类目是哪些？
sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY max_price DESC LIMIT 5

question: 每个供应商供应的商品成本合计是多少？
sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(p.cost) FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name

question: 每个渠道下过订单的客户数是多少？
sql: SELECT c.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.channel

question: 商品数最多的 5 个类目是哪些？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: 下单次数超过 15 次的客户有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 15)

question: 没有收到任何评价的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.product_id = p.id)

question: 退款金额高于平均退款金额的退款有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM refunds)

question: 商品数超过 20 的类目有哪些？
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

question: 有过退款记录但没有任何物流记录的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = r.order_id)

question: 价格高于所属类目平均价格的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id)

question: 只有一笔订单的客户有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

question: 库存数量高于平均库存数量的记录有多少条？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity > (SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM inventory)

question: 评价数多于 10 条的商品，平均评分是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(avg_rating) FROM (SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)

question: 供应商评分高于全部供应商平均评分的供应商有几个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM suppliers WHERE rating > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM suppliers)

question: 实付金额合计最高的客户下了多少笔订单？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY SUM(pay_amount) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: 没有写过评价的客户都在哪些城市？
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews rv JOIN orders o ON rv.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

question: 客户数超过 400 的大区有哪些？
sql: SELECT big.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers c JOIN regions city ON c.region_id = city.id JOIN regions prov ON city.parent_id = prov.id JOIN regions big ON prov.parent_id = big.id GROUP BY big.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 400

question: 同时包含两个以上类目商品的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY oi.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) >= 2)

question: 有过退款但没有支付记录的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = r.order_id)

question: 订单数超过 20 的客户有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)

question: 销售额最高的类目下有多少个商品？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT p.category_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.amount) DESC LIMIT 1)
note: 子查询定位 + 外层计数

question: 库存总量低于全部仓库平均库存总量的仓库是哪个？
sql: SELECT warehouse FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse HAVING SUM(quantity) < (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse))

question: 平均评分低于 4 分且评价数不少于 3 条的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT product_id FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id HAVING AVG(rating) < 4 AND COUNT(*) >= 3)

question: 文章数超过 30 篇的作者有哪些？
sql: SELECT au.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM articles a JOIN authors au ON a.author_id = au.id GROUP BY au.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 30

question: 浏览量高于全部文章平均浏览量的文章有多少篇？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT article_id, SUM(views) AS total FROM page_views GROUP BY article_id HAVING SUM(views) > (SELECT AVG(v) FROM (SELECT SUM(views) AS v FROM page_views GROUP BY article_id)))

question: 一条评论都没有收到的文章有多少篇？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.article_id = a.id)

question: 实付金额高于该客户平均订单实付金额的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT customer_id, AVG(pay_amount) AS avg_pay FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) t ON t.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.pay_amount > t.avg_pay
note: 派生表代替相关子查询：语义等价，但避免了每行重算一次聚合

question: 退款金额合计超过 3000 元的客户有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(r.amount) > 3000)

question: 文章数超过 45 篇的栏目有哪些？
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM articles a JOIN topics t ON a.topic_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 45

question: 评价数多于 10 条的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT product_id FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10)
note: 原题为排序取前 N，并列时答案不唯一

question: 支付金额与订单实付金额相差超过 1 元的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE ABS(p.amount - o.pay_amount) > 1

question: 单个客户的最高订单数是多少？
sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id)

question: 评分低于该商品平均评分的评价有多少条？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.rating < (SELECT AVG(r2.rating) FROM reviews r2 WHERE r2.product_id = r.product_id)

question: 没有任何库存记录的商品有多少个？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.product_id = p.id)

question: 单个作者最多写了多少篇文章？
sql: SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM articles GROUP BY author_id)
